title: The Impact of Infrastructure on Development Outcomes: A Meta-Analysis
Understanding the challenge of decoupling transport-related CO2 emissions from economic growth in developing countries
abstract: The transition to net zero requires full decarbonization of the transport sector, currently one of the leading sources of emissions globally. Transport-related carbon emissions are growing fastest in the developing world. This makes it particularly critical to understand whether low- and middle-income countries are making progress towards decoupling transport sector emissions from economic growth, as well as the extent to which their current emissions trajectory is being shaped by structural factors versus more amenable policy choices. This paper assembles and analyzes a comprehensive dataset on transport-related emissions with uniquely wide coverage of developing countries. The paper employs the Tapio decoupling model to demonstrate that only 36 percent of developing countries achieved (mainly relative) decoupling for transport-related carbon emissions over the period 1990-2018, compared to 70 percent of high-income countries. To shed light on the factors driving transport-related carbon emissions, the paper conducts both index-decomposition and econometric analysis. Index decomposition reveals that there have been only relatively modest reductions in the transport emissions intensity of GDP since 1990, and that these have not been large enough to offset economic growth in middle-income countries and demographic growth in low-income countries. Regression analysis further shows that urbanization and industrialization are important correlates of transport-related emissions, while the correlation of policy choices with reduced emissions is rather weak. Overall, developing countries are lagging-behind in the decoupling of transport-related emissions, and accelerating progress will be particularly challenging due to the very low baseline of transport emissions per capita, and the strong influence of structural factors on emissions trajectories.
abstract_zh: 实现净零排放需要交通部门完全脱碳，而交通部门目前是全球主要排放源之一。与交通相关的碳排放在发展中国家增长最快。因此，理解低收入和中等收入国家是否正在朝着交通部门排放与经济增长脱钩的方向取得进展，以及其当前排放轨迹在多大程度上受结构性因素而非较易调整的政策选择的影响，显得尤为关键。本文汇集并分析了一个综合数据集，其对发展中国家的覆盖范围独一无二。本文采用Tapio脱钩模型，表明在1990至2018年间，只有36%的发展中国家实现了（主要为相对）脱钩，而高收入国家的这一比例为70%。为揭示驱动交通相关碳排放的因素，本文同时进行了指数分解分析和计量经济分析。指数分解表明，自1990年以来，GDP的交通排放强度只有相对温和的下降，且这一下降幅度不足以抵消中等收入国家的经济增长以及低收入国家的人口增长。回归分析进一步表明，城市化和工业化是交通相关排放的重要相关因素，而政策选择与排放减少之间的相关性相当微弱。总体而言，发展中国家在交通排放脱钩方面落后，而且由于交通排放的人均基线非常低，以及结构性因素对排放轨迹的强烈影响，加快进展将尤其具有挑战性。

title: Cost recovery, equity, and efficiency in water tariffs: evidence from African utilities
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Water and sanitation utilities in Africa operate in a high-cost environment. They also have a mandate to at least partially recover their costs of operations and maintenance (O&M). As a result, water tariffs are higher than in other regions of the world. The increasing block tariff (IBT) is the most common tariff structure in Africa. Most African utilities are able to achieve O&M cost recovery at the highest block tariffs, but not at the first-block tariffs, which are designed to provide affordable water to low-volume consumers, who are often poor. At the same time, few utilities can recover even a small part of their capital costs, even in the highest tariff blocks. Unfortunately, the equity objectives of the IBT structure are not met in many countries. The subsidy to the lowest tariff-block does not benefit the poor exclusively, and the minimum consumption charge is often burdensome for the poorest customers. Many poor households cannot even afford a connection to the piped water network. This can be a significant barrier to expansion for utilities. Therefore, many countries have begun to subsidize household connections. For many households, standposts managed by utilities, donors, or private operators have emerged as an alternative to piped water. Those managed by utilities or that supply utility water are expected to use the formal utility tariffs, which are kept low to make water affordable for low-income households. The price for water that is resold through informal channels, however, is much more expensive than piped water.
abstract_zh: 非洲的供水和卫生公用事业在高成本环境下运营。它们同时还需要至少部分收回运营和维护（O&M）成本。因此，非洲的水价高于世界其他地区。递增阶梯水价（IBT）是非洲最常见的水价结构。大多数非洲公用事业能够在最高阶梯水价下收回运营和维护成本，但在第一阶梯水价下则无法做到，而第一阶梯水价旨在为用水量小、往往较为贫困的用户提供负担得起的水。与此同时，即使在最高水价阶梯中，也很少有公用事业能够收回哪怕是一小部分资本成本。遗憾的是，在许多国家，递增阶梯水价结构的公平目标并未实现。对最低水价阶梯的补贴并不只惠及穷人，而最低消费费用往往给最贫困的用户带来沉重负担。许多贫困家庭甚至负担不起接入管道供水网络的费用。这可能成为公用事业扩张的重大障碍。因此，许多国家已开始对家庭接入进行补贴。对于许多家庭而言，由公用事业、捐助方或私人运营商管理的公共取水站已成为管道供水的替代方案。由公用事业管理或供应公用事业水源的取水站，应当使用正式的公用事业水价，而这些水价被维持在较低水平，以使低收入家庭能够负担得起用水。然而，通过非正式渠道转售的水，其价格远高于管道水。

title: Paying the price for unreliable power supplies: in-house generation of electricity by firms in Africa
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper documents the prevalence of in-house generation of electric power by firms in Sub-Saharan Africa and attempts to identify the underlying causes. The analysis is based on two data sources. The UDI World Electric Power Plants Data Base (WEPP), a global inventory of electric power generating units, provides a detailed inventory of in-house generation at the country level. The World Bank's Enterprise Survey Database captures business perceptions of the obstacles to enterprise growth for 8,483 currently operating firms in 25 African countries. Overall, so-called own generation by firms-which has been on the rise in recent years-accounts for about 6 percent of installed generation capacity in Sub-Saharan Africa (equivalent to at least 4,000 MW of installed capacity). However, this share doubles to around 12 percent in the low-income countries, the post-conflict countries, and more generally on the Western side of the continent. In a handful of countries own generation represents more than 20 percent of capacity. Rigorous empirical analysis shows that unreliable public power supplies is far from being the only or even the largest factor driving generator ownership. Firm characteristics have a major influence-in particular, the probability of owning a generator doubles in large firms relative to small ones. Our model predicts that the prevalence of own generation would remain high (at around 20 percent) even if power supplies were perfectly reliable, suggesting that other factors, such as emergency back-up and export regulations, play a critical role in the decision to own a generator.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了撒哈拉以南非洲企业自备发电的普遍程度，并试图识别其背后的根本原因。分析基于两个数据来源。UDI全球发电机组数据库（WEPP）提供了全球发电机组的清单，在国家层面详细列出了自备发电情况。世界银行企业调查数据库则收集了25个非洲国家8,483家在营企业对企业增长障碍的认知。总体而言，近年来不断增长的所谓企业自备发电，约占撒哈拉以南非洲装机发电容量的6%（相当于至少4,000兆瓦的装机容量）。然而，在低收入国家、冲突后国家以及非洲大陆西部地区，这一比例翻倍，约为12%。在少数国家，自备发电占装机容量的比例超过20%。严谨的实证分析表明，公共电力供应不可靠远非导致企业拥有发电机的唯一因素，甚至也不是最大因素。企业特征有重大影响，特别是大企业拥有发电机的概率是小企业的两倍。我们的模型预测，即使电力供应完全可靠，自备发电的普遍程度仍将维持在约20%的高水平，这表明应急备用和出口监管等其他因素在拥有发电机的决策中起着关键作用。

title: Is cost recovery a feasible objective for water and electricity? The Latin American experience
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Given the relatively small segment of the population that faces genuine affordability problems in Latin America, there appears to be a promising case for using targeted subsidies to reconcile the cost recovery objective with social protection concerns. Social tariff schemes of various kinds are already widespread in Latin America, but they suffer from a number of design flaws. Increasing block tariff (IBT) structures are the most prevalent form of social tariffs in the region. These are likely to be more successful in the electricity sector than in the water sector because the correlation between consumption and income is much stronger in the case of electricity than water. Moreover, IBT structures in electricity tend to be much better designed than in the case of water, with lower fixed charges, lower subsistence blocks, and steeper gradients. A number of more sophisticated social tariff schemes are also being applied that combine consumption criteria with some form of socioeconomic screening. These are generally found to perform better than IBTs, although they also present significant room for improvement.
abstract_zh: 鉴于拉丁美洲真正面临可负担性问题的人口比例相对较小，似乎有充分理由使用定向补贴，以协调成本回收目标与社会保护的关切。各种形式的社会电价计划在拉丁美洲已十分普遍，但它们存在若干设计缺陷。递增阶梯水价（IBT）结构是该地区最普遍的社会电价形式。这些结构在电力部门可能比在水务部门更为成功，因为电力消费与收入之间的相关性远强于水。此外，电力领域的递增阶梯结构的设计往往也比水务领域好得多，具有较低的固定费用、较低的生存用量阶梯以及更陡的费率梯度。目前还应用了一些更为复杂的社会电价计划，它们将消费标准与某种形式的社会经济筛选相结合。这些计划通常被认为比递增阶梯结构表现更好，但仍有很大的改进空间。

title: The distributional incidence of residential water and electricity subsidies
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Subsidies to residential utility customers are popular among policymakers, utility managers, and utility customers alike, but they are nonetheless the subject of much controversy. Utility subsidies are seen as a way to help make utility service affordable for poor households and as an alternative mechanism for income redistribution. These arguments in favor of subsidies are countered by serious concerns about their adverse effects on consumer behavior, utility operations, and the financial health of utilities. Both the affordability and redistributive arguments for subsidies are based on the presumption that poor households benefit disproportionately from water and electricity subsidies, that they are well-targeted to the poor. The authors test this assumption by examining the extent to which the poor benefit from consumption and connection subsidies for water and electricity services. Their analysis of a wide range of subsidy models from around the developing world shows that the most common form of utility subsidy-quantity-based subsidies delivered through the tariff structure-are highly regressive. Geographically targeted or means-tested subsidies do better, and in many cases have a progressive incidence, but large numbers of poor households remain excluded. Low levels of coverage and metering severely limit the effectiveness of consumption subsidy schemes to reach the poor. Simulations suggest that connection subsidies are an attractive alternative for low coverage areas, but only if utilities have the means and motivation to extend network access to poor households and only if those households choose to connect.
abstract_zh: 面向居民用户的公用事业补贴在政策制定者、公用事业管理者和公用事业用户中都很受欢迎，但它仍然是诸多争议的焦点。公用事业补贴被视为帮助贫困家庭负担得起公用事业服务的一种方式，也被视为收入再分配的替代机制。支持补贴的这些论点，受到了对其不利影响的严重关切的反驳，这些不利影响涉及消费者行为、公用事业运营以及公用事业的财务健康。补贴在可负担性和再分配方面的论据，都建立在以下假定之上：贫困家庭从水和电的补贴中获益更多，即补贴能够很好地瞄准穷人。作者通过考察贫困人口从水和电的消费补贴与接入补贴中受益的程度，检验了这一假定。他们对发展中国家各地广泛的补贴模式进行的分析表明，最常见的公用事业补贴形式——通过水价结构发放的按用量补贴——具有高度的累退性。按地理区域瞄准或经过家计调查的补贴效果较好，在许多情况下具有累进的分配效应，但仍有大量贫困家庭被排除在外。较低的覆盖率和计量水平严重限制了消费补贴方案触及穷人的有效性。模拟结果表明，对于覆盖率较低的地区，接入补贴是一种有吸引力的替代方案，但前提是公用事业机构有能力且有动机将网络接入延伸至贫困家庭，并且这些家庭愿意接入。

title: The impact of privatization on the performance of the infrastructure sector: the case of electricity distribution in Latin American countries
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: The authors analyze the impact of privatization on the performance of 116 electric utilities in 10 Latin American countries. The analysis makes a number of contributions to the literature on changes in infrastructure ownership. First, this is the first systemic analysis of the impact of privatization on the distribution of the electricity sector. Second, it constructs an unbalanced panel data set of key indicators for each country. Third, it includes a broader-than in past studies-range of indicators, such as output, employment, productivity, efficiency, quality, coverage, and prices, offering a fuller picture of the effects of privatization on consumers. Fourth, this research covers a longer period of time, and evaluates three stages-before, transition, and after-allowing for the identification of the short- and long-run effects of privatization, as opposed to previous analyses'short time series data that do not identify long-run outcomes. Finally, the counterfactual is considered through the analysis in trends. The authors apply two different methodologies. The first methodology uses means and medians from each period and tests the significance of the changes between periods. The second methodology consists of an econometric model that captures firm fixed effects, firm-specific time trends, and heteroscedasticity corrections. When needed, the authorsused firm-specific time trends to better understand the outcomes. The results suggest that changes in ownership generate significant improvements in labor productivity, efficiency, and product and service quality, and that most of those changes occur in the transition period. Improvements in the post transition period-beyond two years after the change in ownership-are much more modest.
abstract_zh: 作者分析了私有化对10个拉丁美洲国家116家电力公用事业绩效的影响。该分析在基础设施所有权变化的文献中作出了若干贡献。第一，这是首次对私有化对电力部门分布影响进行的系统性分析。第二，它构建了一个包含各国关键指标的非平衡面板数据集。第三，它纳入了比以往研究更为广泛的指标，包括产出、就业、生产率、效率、质量、覆盖面和价格，从而更全面地描绘了私有化对消费者的影响。第四，本研究覆盖了更长的时间跨度，并评估了三个阶段——私有化之前、过渡期和之后——从而能够识别私有化的短期和长期效应，而以往分析使用的短时间序列数据无法识别长期结果。最后，反事实情形是通过趋势分析来考虑的。作者采用了两种不同的方法。第一种方法使用各阶段的均值和中位数，并检验各阶段之间变化的显著性。第二种方法是一个计量模型，控制了企业固定效应、企业特定的时间趋势以及异方差修正。在需要时，作者使用了企业特定的时间趋势，以更好地理解结果。研究结果表明，所有权变更带来了劳动生产率、效率以及产品和服务质量的显著改善，而且这些改变大多发生在过渡期。在所有权变更两年之后的过渡后时期，改善则要温和得多。
